shortDescription: Adds PKS authentication method and manages PKS keys

options.name: action
options.description: Specifies which action needs to be performed. C(addpks) adds PKS as an authentication method; C(show) displays the LV ids that are associated with the PKS keys and their status; C(export) exports the PKS keys into a specific file; C(import) imports the PKS keys from the specified file; C(clean) removes an invalid key from the PKS;

options.name: device
options.description: Specifies the devices for which you want to perform the action. Required for I(action=addpks), I(action=export) and I(action=import).

options.name: location
options.description: Location of the file where PKS keys will be exported/imported from

options.name: method_name
options.description: Specifies a name for the PKS method.

options.name: passphrase
options.description: Specifies the passphrase that will be used for importing/exporting PKS keys

options.name: pks_label
options.description: logical volume ID that is associated with the invalid key that needs to be removed
